meta.method: Every material claim re-fetched from live official surfaces via WebFetch/WebSearch on 2026-07-26; dispositions reflect that pass.

claims.claim: www.oddslogic.com is the official marketing site
claims.notes: Re-fetched 2026-07-26. Also newly observed: footer 'Powered by Morphic' (getmorphic.com site builder).

claims.claim: odds.oddslogic.com/OddsLogic/ is the app host used by login and trial links; text fetch shows a sparse shell
claims.notes: Host confirmed as login/trial target. UPDATE: 2026-07-26 unauthenticated fetch returned odds-like content ('8½u-11 -106/+102'), a 'PP' element, a Close control, and repeated 'UNLOCKING ODDSLOGIC' text — consistent with a client-rendered app that renders partial data behind an unlock/paywall overlay, not an empty shell.

claims.claim: freeodds.oddslogic.com is a separate official FreeOdds surface
claims.notes: Returns 'You have reached the OddsLogic FreeOdds page!' + 'Home page' link.

claims.claim: freeodds.oddslogic.com/ol-lite-stage/ is a WagerTalk-branded lite/staging shell
claims.notes: 2026-07-26 fetch shows 'Odds' heading, Close control, 'Loading WagerTalk FreeOdds' twice. Path name '-stage' implies staging; unconfirmed.

claims.claim: odds.oddslogic.com/OddsLogic/?ref=bawk exists; ref parameter semantics unspecified
claims.notes: RESOLVED: official oddslogic.com/wagertalk/ page links odds.oddslogic.com/OddsLogic?ref=wagertalk alongside 'promo code: wagertalk' — ref is a partner/referral attribution code. 'bawk' is another partner tag.

claims.claim: Founded by the team behind DonBest and SportsOptions; exited DonBest 2018; 'pioneers who invented the Odds Screen'
claims.notes: Confirmed verbatim. EXTENDED: leadership named on about page — Rick Allec (Founder/CEO), Mark 'Shark' Simons (Director of Sports), Chris Rasmussen (Director of Sports), Zach Allec (Lead Screen Engineer). Interview adds CTO James Piet (PhD statistics, Wharton) [SECONDARY_ONLY].

claims.claim: API offers pre-match and in-play odds, spreads/moneylines/totals for all periods, player props, event and prop grading feeds
claims.notes: Confirmed 2026-07-26. Marketing claim only; no technical contract.

claims.claim: 35+ providers, 200+ leagues, 100+ markets
claims.notes: Confirmed. See contradiction X01 (50+ sportsbooks on home page, 38/50 in secondary sources).

claims.location: API page (implicit in report's coverage list)
claims.claim: 99.999% uptime claim
claims.notes: Marketing claim; no SLA document, no measurement window, no remedy terms.

claims.claim: Player props listed for NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL with named categories
claims.notes: EXTENDED with counts: NFL 23 prop categories, MLB 15, NBA 10, NHL 6. See contradiction X02 (FAQ lists 'Team and player props' as FUTURE).

claims.claim: 'Quick access', 'lightning-fast API activation', 'intuitive formats', structured API, fully managed/monitored
claims.notes: All marketing language; zero technical specifics.

claims.claim: Alerts: breaking injuries, pitching changes, games at halftime, finals, misc event info; customizable by type and league
claims.notes: Confirmed; delivery channel/payloads still undisclosed (in-product visual/audio alerts confirmed on quick-setup page).

claims.claim: History: 'Yesterday' option and Archive for any date in the past; click odds to view all line movement for that event and sportsbook
claims.notes: Product capability only; retention depth, granularity, correction model still UNKNOWN.

claims.claim: API availability affirmed in FAQ ('Sports Betting API': Easy Integration, Fastest Updates, Fully Managed Data)
claims.notes: Confirmed.

claims.claim: Ticket and money percentages exist; column filters for specific periods or line types; real-time color-coded updates
claims.notes: Confirmed + drag-and-drop column arrangement. No formulas or sample sizes disclosed.

claims.claim: Views (leagues/groups/sets of games), Columns (sportsbooks), Notifications concepts; /quick-setup redirects to /quick-setup/
claims.notes: Confirmed. Notifications: 'visual or audio alerts' for halftime scores, finals, injuries, event updates.

claims.claim: Detects near-simultaneous line moves across multiple books; configurable line constraints, timing parameters, leagues, sportsbooks; beta
claims.notes: Confirmed verbatim. Algorithm, thresholds, output schema remain proprietary/UNKNOWN.

claims.claim: Digital subscription service delivering proprietary data via website; immediate access after payment; recurring monthly/annual billing
claims.notes: EXTENDED: 30-day money-back guarantee for new subscribers; refunds 5–10 business days; cancel anytime, active until period end.

claims.location: Report: no public developer docs found
claims.claim: Bounded search found no Swagger/OpenAPI/developer portal on official domains
claims.notes: Re-confirmed 2026-07-26 AND strengthened: docs.oddslogic.com and api.oddslogic.com return DNS ENOTFOUND — those hosts do not exist. Fresh web searches surface only third-party odds APIs (the-odds-api, OpticOdds, Sportradar), never OddsLogic docs. Absence of public docs is not proof no docs exist for customers.

claims.claim: Three-surface model: marketing / gated app / FreeOdds
claims.notes: EXTENDED to four surfaces: an official partner-landing family exists (www.oddslogic.com/wagertalk/) with per-partner promo codes and ref-tagged app links; WagerTalk embeds OddsLogic-powered odds at wagertalk.com/odds [SECONDARY_ONLY].

claims.claim: Real-time pre-match + in-play odds claimed; transports (REST/WS/SSE/polling) undisclosed
claims.notes: Still undisclosed. No evidence permits naming a transport.

claims.claim: History exists in product; API access path unknown
claims.notes: Unchanged.

claims.claim: Fully managed, monitored API commercially available; contract undisclosed
claims.notes: Contact route support@oddslogic.com confirmed on API page.

claims.claim: Core line types: Spread, Total, Moneyline, Team Total, 3-Way; segments: Halves, Quarters, Periods, Innings
claims.notes: FAQ adds column groupings: Full Game, Halves, Quarters/Periods, Spread, Moneyline, Team Totals, 3-Way.

claims.claim: ER model (sport→league→event→segment→market→outcome; book→line snapshots; alerts; grading; props) is an INFERENCE, not a proven schema
claims.notes: Correctly labeled in source. Retained as recommended consumer model only.

claims.claim: No official identifiers (event/book/market/player IDs) disclosed anywhere
claims.notes: PARTIALLY CLOSED by observation O15: the app bootstrap payload proves stable 7-digit numeric event IDs, rotation numbers, and numeric league/board ids exist internally. Still undisclosed: ID stability guarantees, book/player/market IDs, external crosswalks, and whether the same IDs surface in the B2B API.

claims.claim: Lifecycle flow (scheduled→pre-match→in-play→final→grading→archive) reconstructed conservatively
claims.notes: Kept as recommended model; no state names or transition semantics are official.

claims.claim: Auth mechanism (keys/tokens/cookies/mTLS) undisclosed
claims.notes: Unchanged. NEW secondary signal: WagerTalk advertises one login across WagerTalk/FreeOdds/OddsLogic — implies a shared/SSO account system for the B2C product [SECONDARY_ONLY].

claims.claim: Formats, pagination, sorting, caching, localization all unspecified
claims.notes: Unchanged.

claims.claim: Only observed redirect: /quick-setup → /quick-setup/; no API error model, rate limits, or deprecation policy public
claims.notes: Unchanged.

claims.claim: Betstamp (competitor) claims OddsLogic lacks limits/liquidity data; non-authoritative
claims.notes: Re-fetched. Betstamp also claims: no proprietary 'true line', standard lines only (no alternate lines), limited prop coverage, no bet-tracking integration, '35+ sportsbook feeds', minimal PPH/offshore. Contradicts founder interview on offshore/PPH coverage (X04). All SECONDARY_ONLY, adversarial source.

claims.claim: Fits odds comparison, live monitoring, historical backtesting, settlement, alerts, analytics — with implementation detail unknown
claims.notes: Unchanged; production-suitability matrix rebuilt in this reference.

claims.claim: Recommended: immutable raw store, normalized snapshots, schema versioning, late settlement reconciliation, no hard-coded enums
claims.notes: Sound; retained and expanded.

claims.claim: Contradiction: 'clearly documented/easy to integrate' marketing vs no public docs
claims.notes: Strengthened by DNS negatives (C19). Docs may exist privately for customers; the contradiction is between marketing tone and PUBLIC availability.

claims.claim: Report status: INCOMPLETE; missing endpoint inventory, schemas, auth, transports, rate limits, licensing
claims.notes: Correct then, correct now. Nothing found in 2026-07-26 pass closes the API-contract gap. Verdict remains INCOMPLETE.

claims.claim: Pricing: $99/month Early Release with 7-day free trial; FAQ discloses planned split into $399/month real-time and $99/month delayed tiers
claims.notes: Material commercial fact absent from source report. Founder interview says ~$500/month industry-standard real-time tier planned (X03).

claims.claim: FAQ 'future features': Team and player props, Arb alerts, Positive EV alerts, Individual game information links
claims.notes: Creates contradiction X02 with API page's present-tense player-props marketing.

claims.claim: Official WagerTalk partner page (www.oddslogic.com/wagertalk/) with promo code 'wagertalk' and ref-tagged app URL
claims.notes: Establishes a partner-landing URL family and ref-code semantics.

claims.claim: WagerTalk states one login/password works across WagerTalk, FreeOdds, and OddsLogic; WagerTalk odds pages cover NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, WNBA, NCAAF, NCAAB
claims.notes: Implies shared account/identity infrastructure; not confirmed by OddsLogic directly.

claims.claim: Founder interview (KnupSports, ~Feb 2025): 'direct feeds from fifty different sportsbooks'; SportsOptions was 'very first company to offer a sports betting odds API'; props launching February; arb alerts end of February; CTO James Piet
claims.notes: First-person but non-contractual. Confirms API heritage claim and roadmap; 'direct feeds' assertion bears on data sourcing (scraping vs feeds) but is unverifiable.

claims.claim: docs.oddslogic.com and api.oddslogic.com do not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND)
claims.notes: Negative evidence only — an API could live on any host, including odds.oddslogic.com itself.

claims.claim: Marketing site is built on Morphic (getmorphic.com), per footer 'Powered by Morphic'
claims.notes: Explains why the marketing site carries no app code; the data platform is entirely separate.

claims.claim: App bootstrap payload window.__HDF_TEXT__ observed: proprietary brace-delimited schedule format with stable event IDs, rotation numbers, UTC start instants, PT snapshot header, venue/pitcher fields, write-in/grand-salami/series-price constructs; Tapfiliate+Stripe affiliate/payment stack; coverage across 14+ observed leagues
claims.evidence_class: authorized user browser capture of app page source
claims.notes: Highest-authority technical evidence in this investigation (class 2: direct observation). Point-in-time, undocumented, and excludes odds prices and the live-update channel — does NOT constitute the API contract. Full analysis: observed-hdf-bootstrap-format.json.

contradictions.resolution: UNRESOLVED — 'sportsbooks tracked' and 'API data providers' are plausibly different denominators, but OddsLogic never reconciles them. Ask vendor for the authoritative book list per product tier.

positions.claim: Player props listed as current API capability with per-sport categories
'Team and player props' listed under future features

contradictions.resolution: LIKELY STALE FAQ — props probably shipped ~Feb 2025 and the FAQ was not updated; treat prop depth and prop line-history as unverified until sampled.

positions.claim: Covers regulated apps, key offshore books, per-head shops
Minimal PPH and offshore feeds, North-America concentrated

contradictions.resolution: UNRESOLVED — both secondary, one adversarial. Requires the vendor's book list.

contradictions.topic: Marketing 'clearly documented' vs no public documentation

positions.claim: Easy integration, structured API, intuitive formats
No public developer portal, OpenAPI, or docs host; docs./api. subdomains do not resolve

contradictions.resolution: CONFIRMED CONTRADICTION in public posture; documentation is presumably delivered privately post-sales. Absence from public search is not proof docs don't exist.
